name: lib-fetch-json
description: Reusable building block: GET a URL with retries and a timeout, check that the answer is JSON, and return it.

timeout_seconds.description: Give up on a single attempt after this many seconds

steps.run: node -e 'const text = require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8"); try { console.log(JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(text))) } catch (e) { console.error("Not JSON from " + process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_URL + ": " + text.slice(0, 120)); process.exit(1) }'
